adjudication.rationale: The diff shows two separate, slightly different gates for “sync mode”: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, while `refreshOAuthTokens` additionally requires `userId` (`... && userId`). That means parsing can enter the “minimum schema” path even when the refresh did not use the sync endpoint (e.g., when `userId` is null), so the finding about duplicated predicates diverging is grounded. Also `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, which yields a truthy string/undefined rather than an explicit boolean. However, the claim about a future gate being added is speculative, and the diff alone doesn’t prove a current user-visible failure—so this is best classified as a concrete maintainability/correctness risk rather than a verified defect.
